messages:
Marta (Finance): Partner Tideway reports a confusing pair of lines on INV-2026-3345: a manual goodwill credit for $3,150 then a reversal the next day. Can billing ops look?
Noah (Acct Manager): I pulled the invoice. Lines show GW-APR-2026 $3,150 (CR-2026-41B2) on 05/14 and REV-AUTO -$3,150 (RV-2026-41B3) on 05/15. Customer says they never asked to remove the credit.
Diego (Billing Ops): Looking at audit: a manual credit was posted after SUP-12981. Then our nightly AR-cleaner flagged the refund as "stale" and auto-reversed it. Logs:
```
2026-05-14T17:22:10Z manual_credit acct=tdw-214 invoice=INV-2026-3345 amt=3150 code=GW-SUP ref=SUP-12981 txn=CR-2026-41B2
2026-05-15T02:05:02Z ar-cleaner acct=tdw-214 detect=refund_stale action=auto_reversal id=RV-2026-41B3 amt=3150 reason=stale-refund
```
Noah (Acct Manager): Customer got worried when the reversal showed up. We should make them whole and fix the AR-cleaner rule.
Marta (Finance): Agreed. Policy: if an auto-reversal cancels a valid manual goodwill refund, reapply the credit and mark the account exempt from AR-cleaner for 7 days. Create manual credit for $3,150 and tag rc=ar-cleaner-false-positive.
Diego (Billing Ops): Queuing reapply:
```
vb credit --acct tdw-214 --amount 3150 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-3345 --code GW-REAPPLY-0415 --note "reapply after auto-reversal (ar-cleaner false positive)"
```
ops-bot: Action queued: manual_credit_pending | id=BILL-13009 | acct=tdw-214 | amt=3150 USD
Noah (Acct Manager): I'll draft the message: "Hi Tideway 1 we investigated INV-2026-3345. A manual goodwill credit was applied for your support case and an automated reconciliation job mistakenly reversed it. We've re-applied the $3,150 credit (txn CR-2026-5D9A) and disabled the auto-reversal rule for your account while we remediate. Sorry for the confusion.  "
Diego (Billing Ops): Credit posted txn CR-2026-5D9A. ops-bot: Action completed: manual_credit | id=BILL-13009 | status=completed | txn=CR-2026-5D9A
Marta (Finance): Please add a mitigation ticket on Billing board: AR-cleaner should skip accounts with recent manual_credit ref tags and include a dry-run alert. Tag rc=ar-cleaner-false-positive. Also add ledger note linking CR-2026-5D9A to original txn CR-2026-41B2.
Noah (Acct Manager): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix and the explanation." :thumbsup
Marta (Finance): Closing when ledger reconciles. Thanks all.
